crisis.title.draft: Kì í ṣe ìwọ nìkan lo wà

phase3.gigsHelp.en: Short local jobs. Check parole conditions with your officer. Phone numbers are never shown.
phase3.gigsHelp.draft: Àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ àdúgbò máa ń ṣàyẹ̀wò ohun tó ń ṣẹlẹ̀ nígbà tí wọ́n bá dá wọn láre, wọn kì í sì í fi nọ́ńbà fóònù wọn hàn.

phase3.housingHelp.en: Savings goals plus a housing-readiness plan. Groundwork does not provide housing and does not partner with providers. For local help, call 211.
phase3.housingHelp.draft: Àfojúsùn ìpamọ́ àti ètò ìmúratán ilé. Groundwork kò pèsè ilé, kò sì ṣe àjọṣepọ̀ pẹ̀lú àwọn olùpèsè ilé. fún ìrànlọ́wọ́ ládùúgbò, pe 211.

phase3.paidNote.en: Paid plan. No price has been set yet.
phase3.paidNote.draft: A ò tíì pinnu iye tí wọ́n máa san fún wa.

phase3.tokensHelp.draft: Àwọn àmì náà kò ní iye owó kankan.

reentry.call211.draft: Ìkésíni 211 fún àwọn ohun èlò àdúgbò

reentry.crisisStep.en: Save these numbers now. You can also tap Need help now at the top of any screen.
reentry.crisisStep.draft: O tún lè tẹ Ìrànlọ́wọ́ nísinsìnyí ní orí iboju èyíkéyìí.

reentry.steps.step14.en: Put every court date and check-in on a calendar
reentry.steps.step14.draft: Fi gbogbo ọjọ́ tí wọ́n máa ṣe ẹjọ́ àti àkókò tí wọ́n máa gbà wọlé sínú kàlẹ́ńdà kan

reentry.steps.step17.en: Check your fines, fees and restitution
reentry.steps.step17.draft: Ṣàkíyèsí owó ìtanràn, owó ìtanràn àti owó ìtanràn rẹ

reentry.steps.step19.en: Enroll in Medicaid, and SNAP if you need it
reentry.steps.step19.draft: Ṣe ìforúkọsílẹ̀ fún ètò ìṣègùn, kó o sì gba ìtọ́jú tó o nílò

reentry.steps.step7.en: Find a safe place to stay (call 211 or local housing resources)
reentry.steps.step7.draft: Wá ibi ààbò kan láti dúró sí (pe 211 tàbí ibi ìtìlẹ́yìn ilé ládùúgbò)

reentry.steps.step8.en: Find food for this week (call 211 or a local food pantry)
reentry.steps.step8.draft: Wá oúnjẹ fún ọ̀sẹ̀ yìí (pe 211 tàbí ilé oúnjẹ àdúgbò)

safety.relapseDraft.en: Draft — for review. Calm first steps for the first 24 hours after a slip will appear here once reviewed. You are not alone.
safety.relapseDraft.draft: Àkọlé ìwé  —  fún àtúnyẹ̀wò. Àwọn ìgbésẹ̀ àkọ́kọ́ tó yẹ kó o gbé fún wákàtí mẹ́rìnlélógún àkọ́kọ́ lẹ́yìn tó o bá ti ṣe àtúnyẹ̀wò.

safety.vaultHelp.en: Your documents are encrypted. Paid plan feature; no price has been set yet.
safety.vaultHelp.draft: Àwọn àkọsílẹ̀ rẹ ti wà ní ìkọ̀kọ̀. Ohun èlò ìforúkọsílẹ̀ tí a sanwó fún; a kò tíì gbé iye kan kalẹ̀.

support.resourcesNote.en: Legal aid, treatment and transit. This directory does not cover food or housing.

wellbeing.roughHelp.en: You are not alone. The crisis button above is always here — call or text 988, or 911 in an emergency.
wellbeing.roughHelp.draft: Ìwọ nìkan kọ́ ni o wà nídìí ọ̀rọ̀ náà. Ojú-ìwòsàn tó wà lókè yìí máa ń wà nídìí ọ̀rọ̀ náà  —  pe 988 tàbí kí o fi ọ̀rọ̀ ránṣẹ́ sí 911 nígbà pàjáwìrì.

work.paroleNote.en: Check your parole or probation conditions with your officer before applying.
work.paroleNote.draft: Wá àyẹ̀wò àwọn ohun tó o lè ṣe kó o tó ṣe bẹ́ẹ̀ lọ́dọ̀ òṣìṣẹ́ rẹ.
